releaseNotes: Fixes items missing from the app. The product list was being cut off at 200 items, so brands and item codes visible on the website never reached the handheld - the full list now downloads. Registration, Re-Write and Blank Audit also stop re-downloading the whole catalogue every time you open them, so they open much faster, and each screen now shows how recently its list was synced. Use Sync Data whenever you want to force a refresh.
